The children abducted by Putin’s war machine
October 3|

Tens of thousands of Ukrainian children have been abducted to Russia, subjected to heavy indoctrination and even military training to turn them into soldiers. CBC’s Terence McKenna explains what’s happening and how Canada is leading an international effort to help.
